hypotheses.text: Passing to Ilan Moreau (CM) would have increased the scoring chance compared to the shot — Moreau could have had a higher-probability opportunity or drawn defenders to create a better chance.
Passing to Callum Reyes (RB) would have been a safer option that likely reduced turnover risk and could have led to a more dangerous crossing/shooting situation than Quill's low-probability shot.

If Marcus Quill had carried the ball forward instead of shooting, he might have improved the situation by creating a closer or clearer chance for himself or a teammate, raising the probability of scoring relative to the immediate shot.
